title: rootwise
pitch: An AI gardening advisor that answers from real horticultural data — and says so when the data doesn't exist.
note: Server-backed, so it deploys to Vercel rather than Pages. Point the iframe at the live URL directly, not at wyattlindsey.github.io/rootwise/ — that page is itself an embed shell and would nest one iframe inside another. The app sets frame-ancestors to allow this hub.
